title: Label Reader
subtitle: The exact dose for your tank, from the label
pickLabel: Take a photo of the pesticide label
pickHint: The side with the dose, flat and sharp
tip1: Lay the bottle or packet flat
tip2: Make sure the dose table is in the photo
tip3: No glare — keep direct sun off the plastic
loading3: Working it out for your {{n}} L tank…
doseFor: Mix in one full {{n}} L tank of water
doseSource: Worked out from the dose printed on this label — never guessed.
noDose: Dose not readable on this label
noDoseReason: So we won’t show a number — a wrong dose can harm your crop and you. Ask an expert or your dealer before you spray.
unclearReason: This photo isn’t clear enough to trust the dose, so we won’t show a number. Take a sharper photo, or ask an expert before you spray.
checkReason: Something on this label needs a second look. Check with an expert before you spray.
harvestAfter: Harvest only after {{n}} days from spraying
waitingUnknown: Not printed on this label — ask your dealer before you harvest.
